s: Majority element O(n) time, O(1) space
d: An algorithm to find the majority element (appears > ⌊n/2⌋ times) in a sequence.

p: Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm finds the majority element (an element appearing more than N/2 times) in O(1) space. It works by maintaining a candidate and a counter. Because the majority element appears more than all other elements combined, it will always survive the 'voting' process.
2. If count is 0, assign current element to candidate.

def majorityElement(nums):
  count = 0
  candidate = None
  
  for num in nums:
    if count == 0:
      candidate = num
    count += (1 if num == candidate else -1)
    
  return candidate
Time: O(N) single pass. Space: O(1).
